scripts.tests:start: wp-env start && wp-env run tests-cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/dws-framework-helpers-test-plugin composer run-script packages-update && npm run selenium:start
scripts.tests:run: npm run tests:start && npm run tests:run:integration && npm run tests:run:end-to-end
scripts.tests:run:integration: wp-env run tests-wordpress --env-cwd=project composer run-script tests:run:integration
scripts.tests:export-db: npm run wp-env run tests-cli wp db export project/tests/Support/Data/dump.sql
